why_seated: The French Sappho with the Greek facing, by a poet who answered the fragments in her own poems: fr. 31 given twice, as prose translation, which carries the fifth stanza's opening ('Mais il faut oser tout...'), and as the poem made from it.
research: The revision of Closing the Fragment (v7, a draft of 2026-11-07 for Alexanarch), whose §6 controls the January composition against the translators from Hall (1652) to Carson and whose §8 declares an exposure-checked panel; and the Sappho Future Reader framework, whose groundwork is Research Notes Towards the Future Reader (#1548: Part I the scholarly field, Part II the future reader in twelve strata), and whose reading by a signed-out ChatGPT on 2026-11-07 is seated as capture 0C3D (sappho-future-reader-framework-constitutive-materials-chatgpt-20261107).
